title: Direct gpsd stratum 4 samples accept empty or unverified quality evidence
description: Timing correctness review: `TimeProvider.sample` requires gpsd subtype and a verified flag for Local-client stratum 4 but accepts `quality=None` as an empty mapping, and tracker rejection performs no gpsd time-quality checks. Define canonical immutable gpsd quality fields and validity criteria, reject missing, malformed, or time-invalid quality, and add positive and negative shared vectors plus provider-to-tracker tests.
